decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.6.41 Judge Consequence and Abstention Robustness for release.
rationale: Visionary, Builder, and Guardian agree that the package closes the judge-condition measurement gap with executable structural checks while preserving identical evidence, six-way output taxonomy, abstention review, privacy, governance, no automatic judge action, non-authority, and anti-surveillance boundaries.
recommendation: Release v0.6.41 and begin v0.6.42 Sequestered Replay and Policy-Gaming Detection.
